edits.before: Q-poke from range wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Kled contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You are both fragile at level 1 — chip with Thundering Shuriken from 950 and last-hit outside his 800-range trap.

edits.before: Mark management: third proc stuns — count to three. Only take the trade when Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope is down.
edits.after: Bear Trap yanks you into Skaarl's autos long before you stack three Marks of the Storm for the stun. Give the CS up.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kled must walk into your range.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies gives four fast attacks on a 13-second reset — mounted Kled wins any melee exchange here.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He takes his power trades on Skaarl while you still have no answer to the pull — chip from range, farm safe, and wait for level 6.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom + Zhonya wins any grouped fight top-side. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom plus a Q-W-E mark chain stun-locks him and bursts Skaarl off — your one clean window, and it is 120s.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown.
edits.after: Your first item cashes the R combo into a kill on the dismounted Kled — force every all-in on this timer.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Kled carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He remounts and Skaarl's regen out-sustains your magic once R is down. Close before this, or play the teamfight.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. E-dash/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — 800 range on 11s at rank 1; stay outside it rather than react to it. - Violent Tendencies: 13s, four fast attacks — the attack wind-up is the tell, not a cast. - Your R: a flat 120s.

edits.before: His engage hook. E-dash/dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: An 800-range hook on 11s. Stay outside it; commit only once it is spent.

edits.after: Poke him out from 950, stay outside the 800-range Bear Trap, and take the fight at 6, not before.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Bear Trap on a Rope and how disciplined your pattern is.
